issues.title: PA says yield 3% below last year; it is 9% below
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 para 8.2 says Jan–Jun 2026 yield was 3% below the same period 2025 (7.20 t/ha). 6.53 vs 7.20 t/ha is 9.3% lower, and FFB fell 10.4% (14,032.23 t vs 15,660.18 t). Figures are Juasa A+B combined.

issues.detail: PA section 9 shows estimate to date general charges RM13.90/t, upkeep 146.76, harvesting 118.49 (total 279.15). issues.title: Circle and selective spraying: text vs table
issues.detail: PA 6.3.1 says 1,597.28 ha (82% of 1,955.75 ha) circle sprayed; its table shows 2,677.83 ha of 3,150.73 ha (85%). PA 6.4.1 says 1,859.88 ha (72% of 2,596.66 ha) selective; table shows 2,799.38 ha of 3,536.18 ha (79%). Dashboard uses the table figures.

issues.title: Harvesting rounds do not match 14-day interval
issues.detail: PA 7.3 says 9.4 rounds in Jan–Jun 2026 (about 19 days per round) against 12 budgeted, but PA 7.4 says the interval averaged 14 days. Agro Table 9 shows 10–19 days in Juasa A, Jan–May 2026.

issues.title: Labour required total does not add up
issues.detail: PA labour table (Jun 2026) lists required 46+5+26+4+0+0+22 = 103 but prints total required 108 with variance -10 (93 actual). Variance of -10 matches 103.

issues.title: Manuring: PA says 8 of 8 rounds done, Agro says 73%

issues.title: PA fertiliser doses differ from Agro programme

issues.title: Rat damage: PA census vs Agro and PA total
issues.detail: PA rat census shows 17–33% damage per sub-block but prints a total of 12%. Agro Table 13 (Q1 2026) shows P19A 13%, P20R 17%, P21S 21%, P01K 11% for the same blocks. Both are above the 10% threshold.

issues.title: Pruning status: PA 64% vs Agro about 90%
issues.detail: PA 6.6.1 says 64% of the 5,046.84 ha programme was pruned and calls progress slow. Agro Table 10 shows 90–91% complete for Juasa A rounds 1–5, but it counts P97H (8.1 ha) and P13M (4 ha) as done in its area column while their percentage is 0%.

issues.title: Palm stand figures inconsistent
issues.detail: Agro Table 4 gives 148 SPH for P19A to PN25W, but the PA rat census sheet shows 125–142 SPH for P19–P22 sub-blocks (for example A1 139, S2 125). Agro P92C 9,553 palms over 77.9 ha is 123 SPH, not the 135 shown as current; P01K 18,545 palms over 164.2 ha is 113, not 123.

issues.title: Last-year crop column looks too high
issues.detail: PA section 8 shows last-year column 40,080 t FFB and 18.42 t/ha for Juasa A+B on 2,175.54 ha. Agro gives 2025 yields of 17.42 t/ha (Juasa A) and 9.73 t/ha (Juasa B), so a combined figure above both is not possible if that column is 2025 actual.

issues.title: Flooded area percentage wrong in Agro Appendix 3a
issues.detail: Agro Appendix 3a lists 316.95 ha flooded and prints 45% of 1,146.14 ha. The listed sub-blocks add up to 980.85 ha (32%); the text (4.4) says 21% of 1,537.34 ha. Appendix 3b prints 60% for Juasa B against 40% in the text.

issues.title: Replant felling dates differ
issues.detail: PA says felling and chipping started and completed in June (comment column) or started June and completed July (10.4.1). Agro Table 15 for the 24–25 June visit shows felling 95% in progress, and its text refers to works on 10–11 July 2026, after the visit date.

issues.title: P22T3 yield drop doubtful
issues.detail: Agro Table 16 shows P22T3 falling from 16.90 to 2.65 t/ha Jan–May (-14.25); Agro itself says the figure is doubtful. It also says Juasa B 2025 harvest intervals ranged 9–108 days, likely a typo.
